title: Eject all GPUs
summary: Safely ejects all GPUs currently attached to the Mac. This is a high-impact action that should be used with caution.

steps.explain: Eject all GPUs attached to the system.

rollback.explain: Restart the Mac to re-initialize all GPUs. There is no direct command to re-insert them.

warnings: This will disconnect all graphics processing units.
If you eject the primary GPU, your display may go black or the system may become unusable until restart.
